subject: ISL kickoff — causal explainability for tabular models
body: Team, kickoff for ISL — Invariant Structure Learning — in data-platforms. From our release: ISL learns causal structure that stays invariant across environments, improving generalization and giving causal explanations; the codebase covers environment construction for synthetic and real data (Boston Housing, Insurance, Sachs) and both supervised and self-supervised settings. Product angle: a causal-explainability toolkit for tabular models — partner teams keep asking which features actually drive a model and getting correlational answers. Milestones: repro on the shipped datasets by May 22 (synthetic env generation is scripted — e.g., 3 environments × 100 samples per graph); self-supervised mode evaluated on one partner tabular dataset by mid-June; toolkit go/no-go by early July. Alina owns staffing; Csilla is tech lead. Reminder that Q3 OKR planning locks June 26 — if this is a go, the ask needs to be written by then. — Dmitri
